ac-28-13 ::= [\n] | [^\n] ac-28
decimal-part ::= [0-9]{1,16}
integral-part ::= [0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15}
json-array ::= "[" space ("]" | json-value (space "," space json-value)* space "]")
json-bool ::= "true" | "false"
json-null ::= "null"
json-number ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*) ("." [0-9]+)? (("e" | "E") [+-]? [0-9]+)?
json-object ::= "{" space ("}" | json-string space ":" space json-value (space "," space json-string space ":" space json-value)* space "}")
json-string ::= "\"" ( [^"\\] | "\\" ( ["\\/ bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4} ) )* "\""
json-value ::= json-object | json-array | json-string | json-number | json-bool | json-null
number ::= ("-"? integral-part) ("." decimal-part)? ([eE] [-+]? integral-part)?
root ::= tool-call-root
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}

tool-0-arg-0 ::= ("<parameter=" "tool" ">\n") xml-arg-string
tool-0-arg-1 ::= ("<parameter=" "tracking_no" ">\n") xml-arg-string
tool-0-arg-2 ::= ("<parameter=" "quantity" ">\n") tool-0-arg-2-schema "\n</parameter>\n"
tool-0-arg-2-schema ::= "{" space tool-0-arg-2-schema-value-kv "," space tool-0-arg-2-schema-unit-kv space "}"

tool-0-arg-2-schema-unit-kv ::= "\"unit\"" space ":" space tool-0-arg-2-schema-unit
tool-0-arg-2-schema-value-kv ::= "\"value\"" space ":" space number
tool-0-args-1 ::= tool-0-arg-0
tool-0-args-2 ::= tool-0-arg-1
tool-0-args-3 ::= tool-0-arg-0 tool-0-args-2 | tool-0-arg-1 tool-0-args-1
tool-0-args-4 ::= tool-0-arg-2
tool-0-args-5 ::= tool-0-arg-0 tool-0-args-4 | tool-0-arg-2 tool-0-args-1
tool-0-args-6 ::= tool-0-arg-1 tool-0-args-4 | tool-0-arg-2 tool-0-args-2
tool-0-args-7 ::= tool-0-arg-0 tool-0-args-6 | tool-0-arg-1 tool-0-args-5 | tool-0-arg-2 tool-0-args-3
tool-call ::= "<tool_call>\n" (tool-0) "</tool_call>" space
tool-call-root ::= (tool-call tool-call*)?
